To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
nutrient additions to stream microbial mats in the McMurdo dry valleys, Antarctica can alter the abundance and diversity of microbial mat communities.

nutrient amendments altered the composition and abundance of the microbial communities in the mats of two glacial melt streams, and these changes were consistent with nutrient enrichment of microbial mat communities in other ecosystems.

(1) nutrient additions to microbial mats in two McMurdo Dry Valley streams resulted in changes to community structure, (2) N additions stimulated the growth of filamentous cyanobacterial and diatoms, and (3) P additions stimulated the growth coccoid green and purple sulfur bacteria.
